newsitem.title: THAILAND: GCN to sell stake in Thai Deutsche Morgan.
newsitem.headline: GCN to sell stake in Thai Deutsche Morgan.

text.p: GCN Finance Plc said on Friday it would sell 31.10 percent of common shares it holds in Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities (Thailand) Co Ltd.

GCN Finance said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it would sell its stake at 280 baht apiece compared to 48.38 baht apiece specified in Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities's book value as of last December 31.
The company said it would disclose the identity of the buyer later.
GCN Finance was trading at 14 baht apiece at 0525 GMT on Friday, unchanged from Thursday.
